name: officewrite
description: Officewrite: a free, open-source alternative to Microsoft Word, LibreOffice and OpenOffice. A non-profit educational project, open source for anyone to edit.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/openxml/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @officewrite/core && npm run test -w @officewrite/openxml && npm run test -w @officewrite/desktop
scripts.test:electron: npm run build -w @officewrite/desktop && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
